newsitem.title: USA: Texas Instruments Inc Q1 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Texas Instruments Inc Q1 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Q1 1997 net income includes pre-tax charge of $56 million primarily related to severance actions and other costs associated with the sale of the company's mobile computing business.
Excluding this charge, operating income for Q1 1997 was $138 million, or $0.70 per share, compared to $0.68 for the year-ago period.
Current Q1 net includes income from discontinued operations of $0.14 a share vs $0.16 a share in the year ago period.

The company's defense operations are reported as a discontinued business. As previously reported, Texas Instruments expects the acquisition by Raytheon Co of its defense business to close in the second quarter of 1997.
First Call estimate for Q1 1997 was $0.58 per share.
